collection.title: Audi RS5 Coupe 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit the Audi RS5 Coupe 2017 onwards which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
